channel.title: Bits & Tickers
channel.description: What got built, and what it's worth. Two hosts, Alex and Maya, on tech, AI and markets. First Tick is the day's news in about half an hour, every morning: each story named and sourced in its first breath, and none left without a reason it matters. Day One, on Sundays, tells how one well-known company got from nothing to where it is, then turns that into moves you can make yourself. No ads, chapters you can skip through, and a full transcript with every episode. Every story is linked in the show notes. Nothing in this show is financial advice. Voiced with synthetic voices.
